phases.name: Start of Round
phases.summary: In Rounds 2-5, rotate the single leftmost Market and Imperial Orders; refill displays, ready Techniques, and reset once-per-round Kiln abilities.

phases.name: Work Phase
phases.summary: Players alternate placing one worker and resolving that location until all have passed or placed all workers.

phases.name: Firing Phase
phases.summary: If the kiln is not empty, resolve pre-firing abilities, secret Wood and Fuel Ledger, Base Heat, Shifu repositioning, Fire, Actual Heat, Quality and after-firing effects.

phases.name: Order Phase
phases.summary: In turn order, complete any number of Orders. Imperial Orders advance by their printed +1, +2 or +3 Progress, up to space 5.

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.summary: Return workers, resolve Apprentice unlocks or Round-5 compensation, discard Orders down to 3 (Guan 4), pass First Player and advance the round.
